title: Warm Earthy Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Norwegian stew made with beef stock, binchotan-charcoal, and earthy ingredients, perfect for a cold evening. This dish is gluten-free-friendly and features pillowy soft texture.
instructions: Heat the binchotan-charcoal powder in a large Dutch oven over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the beef stew meat to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef stock, carrots, potatoes, thyme, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
